welcome.title: Welcome to Fast Expense
welcome.descriptionDesktop: A private tracker for you and your partner. Log spending in seconds, always see your real share, and stay on your 50/25/25 plan. Let's set it up — takes a minute.
welcome.descriptionPhone: A private tracker for you and your partner. Log spending in seconds, always see your real share, and stay on your plan.

name.title: What's your name?
name.descriptionDesktop: We'll use it around the app. You can change it later.
name.descriptionPhone: We'll use it around the app. Change it later anytime.
name.label: Your name

sharing.title: Do you share expenses?
sharing.descriptionDesktop: If you split costs with a partner, we'll only count your share toward your budget.
sharing.descriptionPhone: We'll only count your share toward your budget.

income.descriptionDesktop: A ballpark is fine — it sets your 50/25/25 targets. Refine it in Settings anytime.
income.descriptionPhone: A ballpark is fine — it sets your 50/25/25 targets.
income.label: Monthly income (MXN)

budget.title: Your budgeting rule
budget.descriptionDesktop: We default to 50/25/25. Keep it, or tweak — it always totals 100%.

helpers.savings: Its own bucket — pay yourself first

cards.title: Add a payment method?
cards.descriptionDesktop: Tag each expense by card so you see where spend lands. Optional — add or edit in Settings anytime.
